cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with motion meaning governs the accusative case.
The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.
The preposition в (in) with location meaning governs the prepositional case.
Голос is the direct object of the transitive verb подает (raises), taking accusative case.
Господь is the subject of the implied verb 'быть' (to be), taking nominative case.
The preposition до (to/until) governs the genitive case.
Копье is the direct object of the transitive verb расщепляет (shatters), taking accusative case.
The preposition в (among/in) with location meaning governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Потому и не устрашимся мы, пусть даже дрогнет сама земля
reading.question: What should the people not fear according to this passage?
reading.explain: The text states they will not fear even if the earth trembles and mountains collapse, showing confidence despite natural disasters.

reading.ru: Речные потоки радуют Божий город, святилище, где обитает Всевышний
reading.question: What does the text say about the river streams?
options: They bring joy to God's city and holy place
They are a place of darkness
reading.correct: They bring joy to God's city and holy place
reading.explain: Речные потоки радуют Божий город — The river streams gladden God's city (Zion) which is His sanctuary.

reading.ru: Народы метутся, и царство рушится, подает он свой голос и тает земля
reading.question: What is the effect of God's voice according to this verse?
options: The earth melts when He speaks
reading.correct: The earth melts when He speaks
reading.explain: подает он свой голос и тает земля — When He raises His voice, the earth melts, showing God's power.

reading.ru: Придите, посмотрите на дела Господа, какие опустошения Он произвел на земле
reading.question: What are people invited to do?
options: Come and see the works of the Lord and the desolations He has made
Come and worship in the temple
reading.correct: Come and see the works of the Lord and the desolations He has made
reading.explain: Придите, посмотрите на дела Господа — People are called to come and see God's works and the desolations He has wrought.

reading.ru: До краев земли прекращает он войны, ломает лук, расщепляет копье и сжигает дотла щиты
reading.question: What does the text describe God doing regarding weapons and war?
options: He stops wars, breaks bows, shatters spears, and burns shields completely
He gives weapons to all the nations
He makes wars stronger and more fierce
He teaches people how to fight
reading.correct: He stops wars, breaks bows, shatters spears, and burns shields completely
reading.explain: The verse lists specific military actions: прекращает войны (stops wars), ломает лук (breaks bows), расщепляет копье (shatters spears), сжигает щиты (burns shields).

reading.ru: Бог в этом городе, и он не падет, Бог поддерживает его на заре
reading.question: What assurance is given about God's city?
options: It will not fall because God is in it and supports it at dawn
It will be destroyed by enemies
It will be abandoned by God
reading.correct: It will not fall because God is in it and supports it at dawn
reading.explain: Бог в этом городе, и он не падет — God is in the city, therefore it will not fall; He sustains it from early morning.
